description: This file contains an abstract class 'BestFit' which provides core functionality for different best-fit regression algorithms, including methods for calculating the slope, intercept, goodness of fit, and other regression statistics based on input datasets. It appears to be part of a shared library for mathematical computations within the PhpSpreadsheet project.

classes.name: BestFit
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionalities for various regression models used to obtain the best fit for data series within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles calculation of regression statistics such as slope, intercept, correlation, and fit quality based on provided datasets.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns whether there was a calculation error with the data

methods.name: getBestFitType
methods.description: Returns type of best fit algorithm used

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Abstract method to compute Y for a given X, to be implemented by subclasses

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Abstract method to compute X for a given Y, to be implemented by subclasses

methods.name: getXValues
methods.description: Returns the array of X values in the dataset

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns the equation of the regression line as a string

methods.name: getSlope
methods.description: Returns the slope coefficient, optionally rounded to specified decimal places

methods.name: getSlopeSE
methods.description: Returns the standard error of the slope

methods.name: getIntersect
methods.description: Returns the X-intercept of the regression line

methods.name: getIntersectSE
methods.description: Returns the standard error of the intercept

methods.name: getGoodnessOfFit
methods.description: Returns the goodness of fit metric for the regression

methods.name: getGoodnessOfFitPercent
methods.description: Returns the goodness of fit as a percentage value

methods.name: getStdevOfResiduals
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of the residuals

methods.name: getSSRegression
methods.description: Returns the sum of squares of the regression

methods.name: getSSResiduals
methods.description: Returns the sum of squares of residuals

methods.name: getDFResiduals
methods.description: Returns the degrees of freedom for residuals

methods.name: getF
methods.description: Returns the F-statistic for the regression

methods.name: getCovariance
methods.description: Returns the covariance of the data

methods.name: getCorrelation
methods.description: Returns the correlation coefficient

methods.name: getYBestFitValues
methods.description: Returns the array of predicted Y values based on the regression

methods.name: calculateGoodnessOfFit
methods.description: Calculates regression statistics such as goodness of fit, residuals, and correlation

methods.name: leastSquareFit
methods.description: Performs least squares fitting to determine regression coefficients

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regression with datasets and calculates initial parameters
